dedupe_keys.name: bd topo v2 voies ferrees et autres

description: BD TOPO® v2 - Voies ferrées et autres is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by crige-paca.org. The theme "Railways and others" of the BD TOPO contains sections of railway tracks, stations (buildings), as well as all means of transport consisting of one or more carrier cables with a length of more than 100m (telephones, chairlifts,...). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD TOPO® v2 - Railways and Other" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2010-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
